_comment: Edit this file to change proxy settings. Restart the server after changes.
_comment_ssl: Paths to SSL cert and key. Relative paths resolve from the cors-proxy folder. Default points to the project root certs.
_comment_originWhitelist: List of allowed request origins. Empty array [] allows all origins.
_comment_requireHeader: Headers that must be present in every request. Set to [] to disable.
_comment_removeHeaders: Response headers to strip before forwarding back to the browser.
_comment_proxyUrl: After starting the proxy, set this URL in src/js/configs/configs.json > api.proxy
